narrative.overview: Each featured product fills a full-width band in its own app's colours with oversized screenshots bleeding off the edge, on a stone ground with ink text, Big Shoulders Display caps for names and Besley for reading, closing on an ink contact block. The same system translates to a two-page A4 CV with full-bleed strips on white.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed flat colour bands, mirrored alternately
Big Shoulders Display 900 caps over Besley
Two fixed A4 CV pages with an overflow guard

rules.name: The Own Band Rule
rules.body: A product's colours appear only in its band and CV strip; each band re-scopes --ring and ::selection.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Colour is flat full-width fields; no gradients or washes.

rules.name: The Caps Are Names Rule
rules.body: Display caps for names and headings; skills keep official casing.

rules.name: The Shots-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only band screenshots cast shadows, tinted to the band ground.

dos: Do confine product colours to their band and strip.
Do keep slate for the longest-held job and concrete for facts.
Do re-scope --ring and ::selection on new coloured fields.
donts: Don't use gradients, gradient text, washes or glow shadows (ADR 0001).
Don't use Inter or system faces for display.
Don't use uppercase mono labels, kickers or eyebrows.
Don't add a theme toggle or Brittany imagery.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons.
